title: Require explicit GraphQL auth mode for unattended worker deployments
description:
## Problem

The centralized dashboard client defaults non-AWS interactive processes to Cognito. Existing Kubernetes workers and procedure-recovery jobs provide an application API key but do not declare an authentication mode, so unattended commands would attempt an unavailable interactive login.

## Expected behavior

Given an unattended worker deployment
When it starts a dashboard client
Then its manifest supplies an explicit supported authentication mode
And current API-key deployments continue to operate
And role-enabled deployments can select IAM without an automatic credential fallback.

## Acceptance

- Rendered worker and recovery-job manifests contain PLEXUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH_MODE.
- The chart defaults existing deployments to explicit api_key mode.
- iam is an allowed explicit value for role-enabled deployments.
- Invalid values fail chart validation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Behavior-first chart tests first reproduced the workload authentication defect: rendered worker and procedure-recovery workloads omitted the explicit GraphQL authentication mode, and invalid modes rendered successfully. The minimal fix now injects api_key or iam explicitly, omits the API key from IAM workloads, and fails Helm rendering for any other value. Focused chart validation: 11 passed.
